judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the "Earth" link (href /future-planet) in the BBC footer's "Footer navigation" list: Home, News, Sport, Business, Technology, Health, Culture, Arts, Travel, Earth, Audio, Video, Live, Weather. The same "Earth" link to /future-planet is also in the page's main navigation bar at the top. In a site section menu, a link named after a section identifies its purpose: it goes to the BBC's Earth section. The destination Rampa fetched confirms this. Its h1 is "Earth" and its title is "BBC Earth | Environment, Climate Change...", so the link text matches the destination heading exactly. The nav list is programmatically determined context for the link (G53/G91 territory), and the link text alone already describes the destination, so 2.4.4 is met. The packet gave the model the nav ancestors and the destination heading, so this is a judgment error, not missing context. The suggested 'BBC Earth' rename is cosmetic, and the finding's claim that 'nothing around it' says where the link goes is wrong.
